confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable; July accommodation is seasonal and least certain. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (about 1.6x and 1.5x) because direct knowledge is thinner. USD values assume roughly 125 ISK per USD, which is unverified. The FX value comes from search-result summaries of the RBA table, not a direct read of the RBA page, so verify the 15 Oct 2026 USD line before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; benchmarked to Nordic capital price levels (Oslo, Copenhagen, Stockholm) from general knowledge, placing Reykjavik at or above them for restaurants and drinks and at the high end for July accommodation because of high wages and peak tourist demand.

anchor_basis.beer: 0.5 L domestic draft lager at a Reykjavik restaurant, about 1,700 ISK
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a city cafe, about 950 ISK
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: burger or fish and chips at a casual counter restaurant, about 3,750 ISK

anchor_basis.cocktail: standard cocktail at a downtown bar, about 2,750 ISK
anchor_basis.wine_glass: 150 ml house wine by the glass at a restaurant, about 2,500 ISK
